programme.title: A Fondo - Ep. 3
programme.desc: A Serra de Ossa, situada em pleno Alentejo, é a principal elevação desta grande região que ocupa quase um terço de Portugal. Nos ultimos anos a caça maior e sobretudo ao javali multiplica as suas populações permitindo a celebração de montarias com marcado acento tradicional.

programme.title: Trutas No Pirenéu Aragonês
programme.desc: A caça de aquáticas durante o inverno é uma modalidade cada vez mais praticada em plena Terra de Campos. As numerosas lagoas que se formam durante os meses de inverno fazem destas jornadas um verdadeiro prazer onde o cão desempenha um papel muito importante, levantando e cobrando a peça de caça apesar do intenso frio castelhano.

programme.title: Cetrería: El Arte De La Selección
programme.desc: Pilar Escribano es una joven cazadora muy relacionada con el gremio de San Huberto. viaja hasta las montañas de Wittenberg en Sudáfrica para cazar diferentes antílopes destacando dos de montaña muy complicados el Vaal Reebok y el Mountain Reed Buck.

programme.title: Caça De Patos Por Terra De Campos
programme.desc: O nosso especialista em sobrevivência, Maykol García, enfrenta a costa marroquina de frente. A costa mediterrânica de Alhucemas é um dos trechos mais selvagens do norte de Marrocos. As montanhas do Rif mergulham no mar sob a forma de falésias, enseadas escondidas e fundos rochosos. Uma paisagem acidentada e bela, onde o Mar de Alborão conserva toda a sua essência.

programme.title: Las Montañas Del Cabo Oriental
programme.desc: Monteria abierta en los aledaños del lago artificial mas grande de Europa, el embalse de Alqueva. Reconocidos monteros portugueses se enfrentaron al reto de cazar Venados, jabalíes y gamos en un monte espeso donde las jaras y carrascas dificultaban la visión.

programme.title: Frente A Frente Com Alhucemas
programme.desc: Explicación de como ajustar nuestra estabilización para que nos aporte mejor puntería y así poder saber la elección de nuestro visor en función de la modalidad que vayamos a practicar.

programme.title: Monteando En Los Barrancos De Alqueva
programme.desc: A pesca do barbo em El Segura, na sua passagem pela povoação de Cieza, na região de Murcia, guarda um tesouro. Vamos acompanhar António na pesca aos barbos com frutos vermelhos, especialmente com a romã.

programme.title: Os Segredos Do Arco T1 - Ep. 7

programme.title: Barbos Com Frutos Vermelhos
programme.desc: Vamos conhecer as suas águas com a ajuda de dois pescadores submarinos, Javi e Diego, dois granadinos que aproveitam a proximidade do mar para desfrutar da sua paixão, a pesca subaquática. Um dia intenso a capturar predadores do fundo.

programme.title: Play Caza T1 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: A Sierra de Los Filabres é um maciço montanhoso situado na província de Almeria. Não foi há muito tempo que os veados foram introduzidos no local sendo atualmente o lar de espécimes espectaculares, oferecendo uma berreia que atrai cada vez mais caçadores.

programme.title: Pescasub Em Almería
programme.desc: En esta serie grandes pescadores submarinos de la península ibérica, nos van a mostrar sus estrategias en los escenarios de pesca que visitan con mayor frecuencia. Desde las aguas batidas del Cantábrico asturiano, pasando por las aguas salobres del Delta del Ebro o las corrientes infinitas del Estrecho. Apneas para todos los gustos en A Pulmón.

programme.title: Quebec A Vista De Pájaro T13 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: O atum rabilho ou atum vermelho, tornou-se uma das atrações mais procuradas pelos pescadores desportivos. A sua força e a luta desportiva fazem do atum um peixe cobiçado, mas as quotas de pesca impostas à frota desportiva condicionam o ressurgimento de uma indústria recreativa com grandes potencialidades.

programme.title: A Pulmón T3 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: En este capítulo veremos la perfecta puesta a punto de nuestro arco de caza, los ajustes que hay que realizar para que la flecha rompa el papel perfecto y así nos confirme que todo está en correcto funcionamiento.

programme.title: Lago E Rio Em Andorra
programme.desc: Nueva serie de 12 capítulos donde trataremos todos los aspectos que engloban la caza con arco, con especial atención al correcto uso y manejo del arco de poleas. Ajustes, flechas, puntas de caza, visores y técnicas de tiro serán los protagonistas de este viaje de 12 entregas para enriquecer nuestros conceptos sobre el arco.

programme.title: Monteando Na Serra D'Ossa
programme.desc: La serie de pesca a mosca más pura. El famoso festival de cine de pesca a mosca nacido en Canadá llega por fin al canal caza y pesca Tv. Los mejores documentales de pesca premiados.

programme.title: Os Segredos Do Arco T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: A partir da localidade de Vegacervera entramos nas montanhas de Riaño caçando de aproximação o esquivo rebeco e aproveitamos os rios de montanha como é o caso do Torio para pescar as suas trutas bravas com Pablo Castro.

programme.title: Cíes, Robalo Em Cabezos
programme.desc: O rio Júcar, que atravessa Fortaleny, acolhe um dos eventos mais importantes da cena europeia na modalidade Feeder Free, a Iberian Master, temos vindo a enfrentar esta competição do pela mão de um atleta da área, Emilio Blanco.

programme.title: De Viagem: Rebecos E Trutas Na Montanha Leonesa
programme.desc: Javi Urbano se desplaza hasta la serranía de Cuenca para recechar distintas especies. El coto ubicado muy cerca del parque del Hosquillo, cuenta con ciervos, muflones, jabalíes y algo de macho montés.

programme.title: Feeder Free Em Fortaleny
programme.desc: José Boily es un entusiasta cazador y pescador canadiense de la provincia de Quebec que ha diseñado y protagonizado una serie de caza y de pesca que triunfa en Canadá y Francia en los últimos años. Probablemente la manera de cazar en la provincia de Quebec es la más similar a las técnicas europeas. Caza menor con perros de grouses o pequeños urogallos, o en puestos de patos, barnaclas o gansos blancos.

programme.desc: O atum rabilho ou atum vermelho, tornou-se uma das atrações mais procuradas pelos pescadores desportivos. Nesta reportagem vamos vê-lo em acção perto da sua matilha que tem vindo a melhorar desde os anos 90 e conhecer em primeira mão os segredos da sua matilha, uma das mais valorizadas da Extremadura.

programme.desc: Mary prepara porco assado com manteiga de maçã e uma sopa de couve-flor de feijão branco com anéis de chalota estaladiços e alcaparras. Por fim, rabanadas com um doce xarope de cidra de maçã e canela.

programme.title: Aqui Há Sabor T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Bibá Pitta, dedicada à família e à inclusão, recebe Fátima para cozinhar arroz de robalo com gambas, numa conversa sobre aceitação, afetos e o valor da vida em família, partilhando memórias, risos e o exemplo inspirador da filha Madalena.

programme.title: As Receitas Simples De Mary T2 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: A família Frohlick está à procura de um novo amigo peludo que acompanhe o seu estilo de vida ativo e que goste tanto de água como eles. Será que vão encontrar o que procuram ao visitar o Nova Scotia duck tolling retriever, o teckel miniatura e o golden retriever?.

programme.title: As Receitas Simples De Mary T2 - Ep. 17
programme.desc: A família Chambers recebe a visita de três cães resgatados especiais, na esperança de encontrar um novo membro da família. A Abby, um cruzamento de labrador e basset hound, o Liam, um cruzamento de Labrador, pastor alemão e beagle e o Takaro, um cruzamento de Labrador e pastor alemão.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Os Baeumler aceitam a sua situação. Um problema com o barco ameaça as atividades dos hóspedes.

programme.title: A Ilha Do Bryan T3 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Numa casa de férias, onde o tempo abranda, nasce uma cozinha pensada para simplificar os dias e reunir a família. Minimalista, luminosa e cheia de soluções escondidas, este projeto mostra como a elegância e a funcionalidade podem conviver num espaço feito para descansar, receber e desfrutar.

programme.title: A Ilha Do Bryan T3 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Projetada para um apartamento destinado a arrendamento, esta cozinha prova que a discrição também pode ter estilo. Integrada na sala, resistente, funcional e pensada ao detalhe, revela como escolhas inteligentes conseguem equilibrar estética, durabilidade e custo-benefício.

programme.title: Cozinhas À Medida T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Para reduzir o desperdício alimentar, Mary Berg partilha como utilizar os restos de composto em receitas; utilizando restos saborosos como espigas de milho e cascas de batata, Mary faz sopa de milho com parmesão, caçarola de batata assada duas vezes e panquecas de aveia com canela.

programme.title: As Receitas Simples De Mary T2 - Ep. 17
programme.desc: A família Chambers recebe a visita de três cães resgatados especiais, na esperança de encontrar um novo membro da família. A Abby, um cruzamento de labrador e basset hound, o Liam, um cruzamento de Labrador, pastor alemão e beagle e o Takaro, um cruzamento de Labrador e pastor alemão.

programme.title: As Receitas Simples De Mary T2 - Ep. 18
programme.desc: A família Vietri-Mistry está à procura do seu primeiro cão. Visitam o bulldog francês, o setter irlandês e o caniche miniatura, mas parece que mãe e filha não concordam sobre a raça.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T2 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Depois de perderem a casa nos incêndios de Palisades, Nancy e Addam compram a primeira habitação. Jonathan e Drew ajudam o casal a gerir o orçamento e a conciliar gostos diferentes.

programme.title: O Cão Ideal T2 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Após o divórcio, Marisa procura uma casa onde possa recomeçar a vida com os dois filhos. Jonathan e Drew ajudam-na a encontrar um lar que concilie orçamento, trabalho e apoio familiar.

programme.title: Irmãos Scott: Sob Pressão - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Esta noite, Gordon continua o curso de culinária, onde ele nos mostra como cozinhar mais pratos económicos. As receitas incluem rosti de alho-francês e gruyère com ovos fritos, um delicioso crumble de maçã e um super impressionante gnocchi caseiro.

programme.title: Cozinhas Sem Limites Com Gordon Ramsay - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Na Madeira, Vera Kolodzig e Joana Seixas afastam-se dos roteiros habituais para conhecer uma ilha mais autêntica. Uma aventura marcada pelo contacto com a natureza e por experiências ligadas à terra e ao mar.

programme.title: Cozinhas Sem Limites Com Gordon Ramsay - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Em Mafra, Vera Kolodzig e Mafalda Luís de Castro encontram um refúgio pensado para ser partilhado por toda a família, incluindo os companheiros de quatro patas. Um episódio dedicado ao bem-estar, ao descanso e à ligação com a natureza.

programme.title: Eco Reset - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Neste episódio, a busca de Dick e Donna pela armadura no lago continua - desta vez recorrem a uma escavadora - mas conseguirá ela dar o resultado que procuram?.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T1 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Evite que a sua abundância de ervas frescas murche com as receitas da Mary para as utilizar num instante.

programme.title: As Receitas Simples De Mary T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Fátima Lopes vai ao encontro de Milena Kalte, uma antropóloga alemã que cria máscaras feitas com esparto, utilizando técnicas ancestrais e dando uma nova vida a uma tradição secular. Viajamos também até ao barlavento algarvio, ao lugar onde esta arte encontra as suas raízes e onde subsistem os últimos mestres do esparto.

programme.title: Aqui Há Mão T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: O especialista em imobiliário e empreiteiro Scott McGillivray oferece o melhor roteiro para a renovação e o sucesso do aluguer em Scott´s Vacation House Rules.

programme.title: A Casa De Férias Do Scott - Ep. 6
programme.desc: O especialista em imobiliário e empreiteiro Scott McGillivray oferece o melhor roteiro para a renovação e o sucesso do aluguer em Scott´s Vacation House Rules.

programme.title: A Casa De Férias Do Scott - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Esta noite, Gordon continua o curso de culinária, onde nos ensina a cozinhar com especiarias. As receitas incluem um arrojado borrego assado lentamente, uma sopa de milho aromatizada com caril e um simples mas delicioso arroz-doce aromático.

programme.title: Pastelaria Para Todos T1 - Ep. 21
programme.desc: Enquanto Jonathan e Michael preparam a sua mansão para o grande casamento, deparam-se com um problema de esgotos num dos quartos de hóspedes que ameaça inutilizar todo o primeiro piso -com 40 convidados prestes a chegar, o momento não podia ser pior.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Preparar uma grande festa pode ser cansativo mas Mary tem receitas para ajudar te diminuir o stress e dar-te mais tempo para estar com a família.

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Os aperitivos práticos da Mary elevam as receitas clássicas, mantendo-as simples. Ela melhora o anel de camarão normal com o seu cocktail de camarão grelhado e o seu prato de festa inclui uma coroa de rolos de salsicha e popovers de tábua de charcutaria.

programme.title: A Memória De Um Assassino
programme.desc: Alex Lewis é um assassino profissional que se recusa a completar a missão de matar uma criança, o que o torna num alvo a abater. A sua única hipótese é perseguir aqueles que o querem matar, só que ele tem um desafio quase inultrapassável está a perder a memória a um ritmo cada vez mais acelerado.

programme.title: Kickboxer - A Retaliação
programme.desc: Um ano após os acontecimentos de Kickboxer - A Vingança, Kurt Sloan jura nunca voltar à Tailândia. Mas acaba por ser forçado a regressar ao ser dopado e atirado para uma prisão. Para recuperar a liberdade, terá de enfrentar Mongkut, um verdadeiro gigante de 200kg e mais de dois metros de altura.

programme.title: O Hóspede
programme.desc: David é um soldado que se apresenta à família Peterson como amigo próximo do seu filho, que morreu em combate. Só que após acolher o jovem em casa, o casal começa a aperceber-se que há uma série de mortes que começam a assombrar a cidade, e que parecem estar todas ligadas à sua presença.

programme.title: A Crueldade De Peter
programme.desc: No início do século XX, Peter, o filho de 13 anos de uma rica família inglesa, é cruel com as crianças, os animais e os criados. Uma noite, em retaliação pela sua crueldade, é emboscado, atirado para um caixão enterrado no cemitério e esquecido. Até que um século depois ele é reencontrado

programme.title: O Amigo De Sempre
programme.desc: A história verídica e inspiradora de Matt e Nicole Teague e das suas filhas, quando a mãe é diagnosticada com cancro terminal. À medida que as responsabilidades de Matt como cuidador e pai se tornam cada vez mais esgotantes, Dane, o melhor amigo do casal, põe a sua vida em espera para os ajudar.

programme.title: Comportem-se Como Adultos
programme.desc: Grécia 2015 a economia está no caos e o país à beira da bancarrota. Um novo governo revolta-se contra as regras restritivas da União Europeia e inspira milhões de europeus. O Ministro das Finanças grego Yanis Varoufakis vai ser o protagonista desse combate.

programme.title: O Último Dragão
programme.desc: Em Agonos, Braedyn, o último Cavaleiro Dragão, tenta unir reis contra o demónio Abaddon. Ao descobrir que um dragão sobreviveu, ele junta-se a um escudeiro e a uma assassina numa corrida contra o tempo para despertar a criatura e salvar a humanidade da destruição total.

programme.title: Últimas Notícias De Yuba County
programme.desc: Uma mulher do Kentucky a que ninguém dá atenção, Sue Buttons, tenta disfarçar a morte do marido dizendo às câmaras de televisão que ele desapareceu. Só que ela começa a gostar da atenção que o caso lhe dá e vai tentar esticar o mais possível o seu novo estatuto de celebridade.

programme.title: Prisão 77
programme.desc: Em 1977, na transição para a democracia em Espanha, na prisão Modelo de Barcelona, um jovem contabilista aprisionado por um desfalque, junta-se a um grupo de prisioneiros que exigem uma amnistia geral ao mesmo tempo que procura uma forma de se evadir da prisão.

programme.title: A Filha Do Rei Do Pântano
programme.desc: Helena vive uma vida comum ao lado do seu marido e filha, porém, guarda um segredo sombrio ela é filha de um serial killer conhecido como Rei do Pântano, que a manteve 12 anos em cativeiro e que agora acaba de fugir da prisão e vem em busca dela.

programme.title: Segundo Ato
programme.desc: Maya trabalha há 15 anos numa loja onde, apesar dos seus méritos, é preterida numa promoção com a desculpa de que não é licenciada. Sem nada a perder, resolve apostar tudo num alto cargo executivo, com um currículo inventado, provando que nunca é tarde para um segundo ato

programme.title: Backtrace Rasto De Violência
programme.desc: Após ficar ferido gravemente durante um assalto, MacDonald perde a memória e é colocado na ala psiquiátrica de uma prisão de alta segurança. Sete anos passados, é contactado por outro prisioneiro que lhe oferece ajuda para fugir da prisão

programme.title: Snitch - Infiltrado
programme.desc: Com o filho adolescente injustamente acusado de tráfico de droga, John Matthews faz um acordo para trabalhar numa perigosa missão como informador infiltrado junto de traficantes, arriscando tudo, incluindo a família e a própria vida.

programme.title: Réplicas
programme.desc: William Foster é um neurocientista genial cuja mulher e os três filhos morrem num acidente de carro. Secretamente, ele vai tentar clonar os seus corpos criando réplicas, mas vai ter de fazer uma escolha radical ele só consegue trazer três dos seus quatro familiares de volta à vida.

programme.title: Jiu Jitsu
programme.desc: De seis em seis anos, uma antiga ordem de mestres de Jiu Jitsu une forças para enfrentar e derrotar perigosos invasores alienígenas. Mas quando o derradeiro lutador da Terra é derrotado pelo líder dos invasores, o futuro do planeta e da humanidade fica em jogo...

programme.title: Os Miseráveis
programme.desc: Stéphane é um polícia que se muda da província para os subúrbios de Paris, onde se junta à Brigada Anti-Crime e descobre rapidamente o clima de extrema tensão que existe entre os diferentes gangues locais e as forças da ordem.

programme.title: Cano Serrado
programme.desc: Na região Centro-Oeste do Brasil, uma vasta ecorregião de savana tropical chamada Cerrado, o sargento Sebastião fará tudo para vingar o seu irmão, um caminhoneiro morto brutalmente, mas confunde dois policiais da cidade com os suspeitos do crime.

programme.title: Tração
programme.desc: Um grupo de amigos praticantes de motocross é convidado para uma competição única, o MotoAthlon, realizado pelo egocêntrico político DiMello, após a qual acaba por cair numa armadilha.

programme.title: Ice Merchants
programme.desc: Um homem e o seu filho saltam de paraquedas todos os dias, da sua casa fria e vertiginosa presa no alto de um precipício, para se deslocarem à aldeia que se situa na planície abaixo, onde vendem o gelo que produzem durante a noite.

programme.title: Visões
programme.desc: Piloto profissional de uma companhia aérea de topo, Estelle vive uma vida perfeita com o seu marido Guillaume, até ao dia em que, num corredor do aeroporto, se cruza com Ana, uma fotógrafa com quem teve um romance apaixonado há 20 anos, e que a vai lançar numa espiral de pesadelos.

programme.title: O Livro Das Soluções
programme.desc: Marc é um realizador de cinema que leva toda a sua equipa de produção para a pequena aldeia de Cévennes, onde a sua a criatividade gera milhões de ideias que o mergulham no caos total, o que o leva a escrever um guia de conselhos práticos, O Livro das Soluções

programme.title: Projeto 725
programme.desc: A filha do CEO de uma empresa de tecnologia é raptada por um grupo terrorista que pretende roubar o poderoso programa informático Projeto 725 para causar estragos por todo o mundo. No meio do caos, só um destemido grupo de mercenários poderá evitar o pior

programme.title: Charada
programme.desc: Depois de se apaixonar pelo elegante Peter numas férias na neve, Regina regressa a Paris onde descobre que o marido, de quem se estava a divorciar, foi assassinado, e que há três ex-soldados a persegui-la pela fortuna que roubaram durante a guerra. Em quem poderá ela confiar

programme.title: A Linha Do Horizonte
programme.desc: O piloto de um pequeno avião tem um ataque cardíaco em pleno voo rumo a uma ilha tropical. Para salvarem as suas vidas, Sara e Jackson, um casal de ex-namorados, terão de conseguir manter a aeronave no ar e encontrar o caminho de regresso a terra

Quando uma arma ultrassecreta cai em mãos erradas, a agente da CIA Mason Mace Brown terá de unir forças com a sua rival Marie, com a antiga aliada do MI6 Khadijah e ainda com a hábil psicóloga colombiana Graciela, numa perigosa missão na qual terão de enfrentar a misteriosa Lin Mi Sheng.

programme.title: Uma Noite Com O Presidente
programme.desc: Andrew Shepherd é um Presidente dos EUA viúvo, que se apaixona por uma ecologista de um grupo de pressão e que, quando começa a sair com ela, vê-se a perder votos a toda a velocidade.

programme.title: Um Desastre De Artista
programme.desc: Motivados pelo sonho do cinema, Tommy Wiseau e Greg Sestero mudam-se para Los Angeles e decidem financiar a sua própria produção, resultando na criação de The Room, considerado um dos piores filmes de sempre mas também um dos mais icónicos.

programme.title: Instinto Predador
programme.desc: Um navio grego transporta animais exóticos perigosos da Amazónia, incluindo um raro jaguar branco. Nessa mesma embarcação, um assassino, que estava a ser extraditado em segredo para os EUA, consegue fugir e libertar todos os animais em cativeiro, deixando os tripulantes em perigo de vida.

programme.title: Boss Level - O Último Nível
programme.desc: Preso num loop temporal que repete constantemente o dia que desemboca na sua morte, Roy Pulver, um antigo agente das forças especiais, empreende uma corrida contra o tempo para tentar acumular informação que evite o seu desfecho fatal e salve a mulher que ama.

programme.title: O Enigma Da Rosa
programme.desc: Uma família vê a filha mais nova ser raptada a caminho da escola e recebe uma carta do raptor a pedir um encontro antes de libertá-la. Para surpresa de todos, em vez de dinheiro, o raptor quer a confissão do segredo de um dos membros da família.

programme.title: Dvorák - Rusalka
programme.desc: Bulgarian conductor Pavel Baleff conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Opéra de Limoges in a performance of Antonín Dvorák’s lyric fairytale opera Rusalka (1900). The work’s libretto is written by Czech poet Jaroslav Kvapil. Rusalka, an elusive water nymph, falls in love with the Prince, who happens to swim in her lake. Rusalka longs to become human herself so that she can be together with the Prince.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 7, nicknamed 'Song of the Night,' is a five-movement, entirely instrumental work composed during a more optimistic period, featuring unique orchestral colors from instruments like the mandolin, guitar, and euphonium. The work's unique sonic palette, including unusual instrumentation and contrasting timbres, along with its deeply expressive nature and sense of journey, are most valued by the public.

programme.title: Hans van Manen – Moving to Music
programme.desc: Dutch choreographer Hans van Manen (1932) is internationally recognized as one of the grand masters of contemporary ballet. His over 150 ballets all bear his distinct signature, featuring a great clarity in structure, refined simplicity and an aversion to decorative frills.

programme.title: Dvorák – Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1–8)
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Antonín Dvorák’s spirited Slavonic Dances, Op. 46 (Nos. 1-8). These 16 folk dances earned Dvorák, who was a relative newcomer when he wrote them, great success. Originally composed for piano four hands, the London Symphony Orchestra plays the orchestral version of these brilliant works. This performance was recorded at LSO St.

programme.title: Grieg - Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Edvard Grieg’s Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16. French pianist Pascal Amoyel features as the soloist. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. It is the composer’s only concerto. The work premiered on April 3, 1869 in Copenhagen, Denmark, with Edmund Neupert as the soloist, and was received enthusiastically.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Das Lied von der Erde
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra in Gustav Mahler’s poignant song cycle ‘Das Lied von der Erde’ (The Song of the Earth). Joining him are two of today's leading vocalists: mezzo-soprano Magdalena Kožená and tenor Andrew Staples. Written in the final years of his life, Mahler’s masterpiece contemplates the beauty of life and the sorrow of parting through some of his most personal and beautiful symphonic writing.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 5
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Bach - Goldberg Variations (BWV 988)
programme.desc: Chinese pianist Zhu Xiao-Mei performs J. S. Bach's Goldberg Variations (BWV 988) at the Leipzig Bach Festival. This June 2014 concert was recorded at St. Thomas Church, where Bach spent most time of his career as 'Thomaskantor', the musical director of the Thomanerchor church choir. The Goldberg Variations consist of one aria and a set of 30 variations.

programme.title: Chopin - Introduction And Polonaise, Op. 3
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform Frédéric Chopin’s Introduction and Polonaise brillante in C major, Op. 3. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: Heavenly Voices - The legacy of Farinelli
programme.desc: The documentary 'Heavenly Voices – The Legacy of Farinelli' (2012) tells us the story of the castrato in music – male singers who were castrated at a young age in order to preserve their high vocal range, a cruel practice that was in place mainly in the 17th and 18th centuries.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: 'It would be hard to find anything greater, more significant or more moving anywhere in musical life today: total harmony of mind and heart, poetry and outcry, fear and consolation, knowing and feeling,' declared the Berne paper Der Bund after this stunning performance of Mahler's Resurrection Symphony in August 2003 by the newly founded Lucerne Festival Orchestra.

programme.title: Septets by Mozart and Beethoven
programme.desc: The soloists from the Lucerne Festival Orchestra present two septets in this engaging 2020 concert, recorded at Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland. It opens with Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 11 in D major, K. 251, known as the ‘Nannerl-Septet’. Mozart composed it in 1776, probably on the occasion of his sister Maria Anna’s name day, whose nickname was ‘Nannerl’.

programme.title: The Unanswered Ives
programme.desc: “The Unanswered Ives” is the first documentary about American modernist composer Charles Ives (1874-1954). Ives was among the first generation of American composers that achieved international acclaim. Born in 1874, in Danbury, Connecticut, Ives took music lessons at a young age, becoming a church organist at the age of 14.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 6
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 2, 14 And 16
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Glass - Double Concerto for Two Pianos
programme.desc: As part of a new collaboration with the famous composer of 'music with repetitive structures' Philip Glass, French pianists Katia and Marielle Labèque perform the European premiere of Glass's Concerto for two pianos with the Orchester de Paris. The program continues with Shostakovich's Symphony No.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: 'It would be hard to find anything greater, more significant or more moving anywhere in musical life today: total harmony of mind and heart, poetry and outcry, fear and consolation, knowing and feeling,' declared the Berne paper Der Bund after this stunning performance of Mahler's Resurrection Symphony in August 2003 by the newly founded Lucerne Festival Orchestra.

programme.title: Kristine Opolais Recital
programme.desc: Critics praise her, and the audience loves her. Kristine Opolais, the prima donna and the star of the New York Metropolitan Opera, performs in her home country Latvia. She gives a splendid concert with the Latvian National Symphony Orchestra, at the Latvian National Opera, in 2017. The program includes arias from operas that made Kristine an international star.

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasiestücke Op. 73
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s well-known Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. With Sir Simon Rattle's mischievous enthusiasm, this famous heavyweight symphony sounds new again. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke’s in London, UK, on September 23, 2020.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Welser-Möst conducts Farrenc, Ravel And Mussorgsky
programme.desc: Franz Welser-Möst conducts the Cleveland Orchestra in a program recorded at Severance Music Center in Cleveland in March 2023. On the program are Louise Farrenc's Symphony No. 3, Ravel's Piano Concerto in G (featuring Vïkingur Ólafsson as soloist) and Mussorgsky's Pictures at an Exhibition (orchestration by Ravel).

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36. Completed in 1802, the work saw its first performance at the Theater an der Wien on April 5, 1803. That same concert also included the premieres of the composer’s Piano Concerto No.

programme.title: Heyward conducts Dvorák’s Symphony No. 9
programme.desc: American conductor Jonathon Heyward makes his debut with the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) with this performance of Antonín Dvorák’s beloved Symphony No. 9 in E minor, Op. 95, 'From the New World'. Composed during Dvorák’s stay in the United States, the work blends Bohemian warmth with the rhythms and spirit of American musical traditions.

programme.title: Chopin - Piano Concerto No. 2, Op. 21
programme.desc: Antoni Wit conducts the Warsaw Philharmonic Orchestra in performance of Frédéric Chopin's Piano Concerto No. 2, Op. 21. Evgeny Kissin features as the soloist. This concert was part of the celebration of Chopin's 200th anniversary in 2010. Chopin composed the second concerto one year before the Concerto No. 1 and completed both works at the age of 20, before leaving his home country Poland and moving to Paris.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1 for chamber orchestra
programme.desc: As part of the ‘Da Camera’ concert series of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid, the Spanish Grupo Fundación Mutua Madrileña performs Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1 in D major, ‘Titan’, in an arrangement for chamber orchestra by conductor Francisco Alonso Serena. The slowly starting opening movement of the symphony depicts the awakening of nature in spring.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28.

programme.title: J. S. Bach – Christmas Oratorio, BWV 248
programme.desc: Traditionally, many ensembles festively announce the Christmas season with a performance of Johannes Sebastian Bach’s Christmas Oratorio, BWV 248. It consists of six cantatas originally intended for performance on one of the major feast days of the Christmas period. The work saw its first performance in 1734, at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Germany, where Bach occupied the position of cantor.

programme.title: Schumann - Humoreske, Op. 20
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Humoreske in B-flat major, Op. 20. Schumann composed the work in 1839 and dedicated it to German-Austrian composer Julie von Webenau. The piece’s title refers to humor as an emotional state.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Final: Schumann, Sibelius a. o.
programme.desc: Baritone Arvid Fagerfjäll (Sweden, 1991) and pianist Hikaru Kanki (Japan, 1993) perform ‘Lust der Sturmnacht’ from Robert Schumann’s Kerner-Lieder, Op. 35; ‘Le diable dans la nuit’ from Henriëtte Bosmans’ Dix mélodies; Franz Schubert’s Totengräbers Heimweh, D.

programme.title: Chopin - Ballade No. 4, Op. 52
programme.desc: Italian pianist Roberto Prosseda performs Frédéric Chopin's technically challenging Ballade No. 4 in F minor, Op. 52. Completed in 1842, this piece is celebrated as a masterpiece within the Romantic piano repertoire, renowned for its intricate structure and profound emotional depth. This performance was recorded at the stunning baroque palace Villa Contarini in Piazzola sul Brenta, Italy, in 2006.

programme.title: Beethoven Violin Concerto And Bizet Symphony in C
programme.desc: Young Venezuelan conductor Glass Marcano is a rising star. Having played in various local youth and symphony orchestras as a violinist, her first experience conducting an ensemble followed in 2012. In September 2020, she won the Orchestra Prize at La Maestra Competition – the first orchestra direction contest for women – held in Paris.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 12, Op. 127
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: In the Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: This episode of the series 'In the Artist's Workshop' features a masterclass by French classical pianist Philippe Cassard in the works of Claude Debussy.

programme.title: Chopin - Polonaise-fantaisie, Op. 61
programme.desc: Ukrainian-born pianist Inna Faliks performs Frederic Chopin's Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61. Recorded at the Nicols Concert Hall, Evanston, IL, USA. Faliks has established herself as one of the most communicative, and poetic artists of her generation. The Polonaise-Fantaise was dedicated to Mme A. Veyret, composed and published in 1846.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: Ukrainian conductor Kirill Karabits leads the London Symphony Orchestra in a stunning performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 4. The soloist is soprano Lucy Crowe. Mahler’s Fourth Symphony opens with the sound of sleighbells and melodies of childlike innocence. But between this deceptively playful opening and the serene finale – a child’s vision of Heaven – lies a world of profound emotion and beauty.

programme.title: Patmos – A musical documentary
programme.desc: Every summer, the Greek island of Patmos hosts the Patmos Musical Festival, a unique musical event comprising both a Chamber and a Sacred Music Festival. This documentary captures the 2024 edition, featuring performances by distinguished soloists and ensembles from around the world.

programme.title: Berlioz - Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Hector Berlioz’s Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. Berlioz wrote the piece of program music in 1830 while still a conservatory student.

programme.title: Piano works by Bruckner
programme.desc: Lithuanian pianist Vadim Chaimovich (*1978) has won several prizes at international piano competitions, such as the Schubert Competition in Dortmund, the William Kapell International Piano Competition in Maryland, and the 29th Masterplayers International Music Competition in Lugano. Moreover, the pianist has performed in several European countries, Japan, and the USA , and has played at many international music festivals.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: J. S. Bach - Chamber music
programme.desc: Philippe Herreweghe conducts his Collegium Vocale Gent in this chamber music program dedicated to the music of J. S. Bach. On the program are Bach’s Orchestral Suite No. 4 in D major, BWV 1069; Gott der Herr ist Sonn und Schild, BWV 79; and Missa brevis in G major, BWV 236. The soloists are soprano Dorothee Mields, tenor Thomas Hobbs, countertenor Alex Potter, and bass Peter Kooij.

programme.title: Mozart - Symphony No. 34, KV. 338
programme.desc: Maestro Iván Fischer leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a remarkable concert program of works by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Antonín Dvorák. Mozart’s Symphony No. 34 in C major, K. 338 opens the program. Completed in the summer of 1780, this was the last symphony Mozart wrote in Salzburg, where he worked as a court musician.

programme.title: Recursivo
programme.desc: The Mexico City Ballet (MXCB) is a contemporary ballet company made up of highly experienced international dancers, residents of Mexico City. International guest dancers help celebrate the anniversary gala of the Mexico City Ballet, featuring the fantastic works of MXCB’s resident choreographer, Yazmín Barragán.

programme.title: Chamber music by Haydn, Chausson And Mendelssohn
programme.desc: Discover the next generation of chamber music talent from the Reina Sofía School of Music. In the first half of this program, Trio Michelangeli presents two masterpieces: Joseph Haydn’s Piano Trio No. 39 in G major, nicknamed ‘Gypsy’, followed by the romanticism of Ernest Chausson’s Piano Trio in G minor. The concert concludes with a performance by the Erinys Quartet of Felix Mendelssohn’s inventive String Quartet No. 2 in A minor.

programme.title: Antonio Manna: Il basso napolitano
programme.desc: Stefano Demicheli conducts the Ensemble Talenti Vulcanici and soloists Nicola Cianncio (bass) and Catherine Jones (cello) in a varied baroque music program, recorded at Chiesa di Santa Caterina da Seina in Naples, Italy.

programme.title: Grieg - Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Edvard Grieg’s Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16. French pianist Pascal Amoyel features as the soloist. Grieg composed the work in 1868, drawing inspiration from Norwegian folk music. It is the composer’s only concerto. The work premiered on April 3, 1869 in Copenhagen, Denmark, with Edmund Neupert as the soloist, and was received enthusiastically.

programme.title: Prokofiev - Excerpts from Romeo And Julia, Op. 64
programme.desc: The beautiful Mariinsky Theatre in St. Petersburg formed the background for the 1996 edition of the annual Europakonzert of the Berliner Philharmoniker. In honour of the Russian hosts, the concert opened with highlights from Prokofiev's 'Romeo and Juliet', followed by the Cavatina from Rachmaninoff's opera 'Aleko'.

programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Works for cello and piano by Schumann, Chopin a.o.
programme.desc: In Geneva, the Swiss city where she has spent most of her life, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich invites her lifelong music partner, the cellist Mischa Maisky, to play chamber music. Between the pieces, Martha opens up to her daughter Annie Dutoit in an intimate interview that addresses both their relationship and the music.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Sonata No. 13, KV 333
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Homage to Yehudi Menuhin
programme.desc: On 22 April 2016, Yehudi Menuhin would have celebrated his 100th birthday. One of his most famous students - and one of his best friends - is violinist Daniel Hope. For him, Yehudi Menuhin was the reason he become a violinist. At first, his mother became the secretary of Menuhin when Daniel Hoe and his parents moved to London.

programme.title: Martha Argerich – A Birthday Celebration - II
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op.

programme.title: Who has stolen the Boléro by Maurice Ravel?
programme.desc: One of the world’s most popular pieces of classical music, Maurice Ravel’s Boléro (1928), was no longer copyrighted as of May 1, 2016. Up to then it had made Ravel and his heirs millions. Ravel died in 1937 and left all he owned to his brother Edouard. Edouard’s death in 1960 unleashed a complex legal battle over the rights, involving among others Edouard’s nurse and her husband.

programme.title: The Four Seasons
programme.desc: We all know 'The Four Seasons of Vivaldi', it is one of the 'hits' of classical music. What if the Antonio Vivaldi’s famous Four Seasons had been preceded by those of Giovanni Antonio Guido, star violinist of Parisian orchestras of the maturity of Louis XIV?

programme.title: CNN Newsroom Sunday
programme.desc: The latest news and information from around the world.

programme.title: CNN Newsroom Sunday
programme.desc: The latest news and information from around the world.

programme.title: CNN 360º
programme.desc: Apresentado por Francisco David Ferreira. CNN 360 é um programa de informação e análise que oferece uma visão completa sobre os acontecimentos mais relevantes do mundo. Todos fins de semana, percorremos os principais temas da atualidade com rigor jornalístico, contexto e diversidade de perspectivas, explicamos o que está a acontecer e porquê. Especialistas, correspondentes e dados em tempo real ajudam a decifrar cenários complexos.

programme.title: CNN Meia Noite
programme.desc: Fecha-se um ciclo noticioso e abre-se outro. Recordamos os temas que marcaram as últimas hora e ganhamos balanço para um novo dia, espreitando as capas dos jornais e os destaques da imprensa nacional e internacional.

programme.title: O Caso Telegram
programme.desc: O Caso Telegram

programme.title: CNN M2 - Metro Quadrado
programme.desc: Um programa dedicado ao estado da arte no setor imobiliário em Portugal. Aqui, vamos ficamos a conhecer a realidade deste mercado, num tom aspiracional, mas realista, dirigido a todas famílias mas também aos agentes do setor. Ajudamos a conseguir bons negócios para a compra ou arrendamento, além de úteis conselhos para viver a sua casa! Mas não ficamos por aqui.

programme.title: GTI Plus
programme.desc: GTi é um programa semanal de informação e entretenimento, essencialmente dedicado aos automóveis e à sua utilização nos diversos contextos - quotidiano, profissional, em viagem, competição.

programme.title: CNN Portugal Summit
programme.desc: O canal que veio marcar a diferença na informação da televisão portuguesa inicia um ciclo de conferências que pretende contribuir para o debate público. O final de fevereiro chega com o regresso de duas CNN Portugal Summit, cujo tema incide sobre o turismo nacional. O mote da conferência é “Portugal Tour, o debate sobre o turismo”.

programme.title: Amanpour
programme.desc: O programa Amanpour é um programa sobre assuntos globais apresentado por Christiane Amanpour, jornalista da CNN, que apresenta entrevistas aprofundadas com líderes globais, influenciadores culturais e personalidades de destaque sobre questões críticas globais e nacionais.

programme.title: Pitch
programme.desc: No Pitch mostramos o mundo por detrás das marcas! As marcas desempenham um papel central na forma como vivemos em sociedade. Estão em todo o lado. Nos nossos ecrãs, casas, escritórios, na rua e a sua gestão nunca foi tão complexa! Neste programa vamos revelar os rostos que estão por detrás da gestão diária de marcas globais.

programme.title: O Admirável Mundo Com Richard Quest
programme.desc: O programa de viagens de Richard Quest pode, segundo o próprio, ser resumido numa frase: “vamos a lugares interessantes para conhecer pessoas fascinantes”. Quest viaja de cidade em cidade, procurando compreender o que move cada uma e as pessoas que nela vivem. O programa é também uma oportunidade para conhecer as personalidades e as histórias de cada lugar.

programme.title: Novo Dia
programme.desc: Queremos que os portugueses comecem o dia bem informados, na companhia da CNN Portugal. Por isso, no arranque da emissão, a atualidade é apresentada ao ritmo a que se desenrola a manhã de cada novo dia: com dinamismo, com energia. Em direto e a partir dos estúdios de Lisboa e do Porto, vamos estar de olhos postos em tudo o que acontece no continente, nas ilhas, em todas as geografias.

programme.title: CNN Hoje
programme.desc: Os temas que estão a marcar o dia e que vão ditar a atualidade passam por aqui. Com repórteres na rua, vamos olhar para os acontecimentos; com convidados em estúdio, vamos dissecar os factos. Este é o espaço da notícia com análise.

programme.title: CNN Meio Dia

programme.desc: Neste programa documental de uma hora, acompanhamos um dia completo na vida de uma pessoa, que pode ser uma celebridade, um artista, um artesão ou alguém anónimo, como um taxista. programme.title: Documentário: 1820 - Revolução Liberal
programme.desc: Este documentário faz um retrato do Portugal oitocentista nos alvores do liberalismo. Uma análise dos factos ocorridos no Porto a 24 de agosto de 1820, o perfil político e socio-económico de uma revolta e as suas implicações, num país sob o domínio estrangeiro com a Corte ausente no Brasil.

programme.title: De Gente And De Vinha: O Último Negociante De Vinhos
programme.desc: De Gente And De Vinha, um retrato intimista do mundo vitivinícola, apresentado com o requinte e poesia do chef André Magalhães, percorre conversas e deambulações por entre quintas familiares, castas em extinção, tabernas e adegas centenárias.'Num território moldado pelo mar e pelo vento, onde ao longo dos séculos a vinha e os homens aprenderam a sobreviver na areia, António Bernardino Paulo da Silva continua a resistir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 71
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 91
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: Non Stop Travels: The Story of Michel Petrucciani
programme.desc: This film portrays Michel Petrucciani 's very unique outlook on life, his vitality, boisterous humor and marked comedian talent which triumphes over all physical restrictions. It also shows Michel Petrucciani performing, composing, selecting his very own piano, at a recording session with Stephane Grapelli, Roy Haynes and Georges Mraz, .... and much more.

programme.title: Woody Herman's Swinging Herd live in England 1964
programme.desc: Woody Herman: Live in '64 features a blistering one-hour concert from 1964 showcasing one of the very hottest line-ups of the 'Swinging Herd,' including trumpeter Bill Chase, trombonist Phil Wilson, and the amazing saxophonist Sal Nistico on the front line, as well as drummer Jake Hanna, bassist Chuck Andrus, and pianist-arranger Nat Pierce in the rhythm section.

programme.title: Solo Piano Summit
programme.desc: When renowned jazz pianists of the old and new school meet at a 'Solo Piano Summit,' audiences are treated to many an interesting musical surprise. The 'Solo Piano Summit' brings together a handful of top pianists with different musical backgrounds: Jacky Terrasson, Junior Mance, Geoff Keezer, Bill Charlap and Alex Wilson.

programme.title: Ella Fitzgerald - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1979, American singer Ella Fitzgerald gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Josh Evans - Pier One Import
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Come Twogether ft. Benjamin Herman
programme.desc: Instead of children’s songs, the sound of jazz standards was always present. They practiced intricate drum rhythms instead of Bach etudes: Simon Oslender and Jérôme Cardynaals have jazz running through their veins! Under the name ‘Twogether’ both youngsters celebrate a very unique and soulful style of funky blues-jazz. They create a sound that leaves even renowned jazz artists speechless.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Chick Corea And Gary Burton - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Gregory Porter - Jazz a Vienne
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne’ is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2012 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was vocalist Gregory Porter transcends the jazz bubble.

programme.title: Tribute to Django Reinhardt: Bireli Lagrene
programme.desc: Biréli Lagrène is a French jazz guitarist born on September 4, 1966 in a family of gypsy tradition. His brother and his father introduced him from an early age to the repertoire of Django Reinhardt, whose influence is still felt in the style of Lagrène. In this performance, Lagrène pays homage to Django Reinhardt with his son, Babik Reinhardt.

programme.title: Down
programme.desc: Two top-tier Belgian musicians – guitarist Philip Catherine and bassist Jean-Louis Rassinfosse – accompany American jazz trumpeter and vocalist Chet Baker during this 1985 performance at the beautiful Brussels Jazz Club, located on the Grand-Place, the Belgian capital’s central square. The trio plays Charlie Mariano’s “Crystal Bells”, the title track of their acclaimed 1983 album.

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour.

programme.title: Face au Public: Odetta
programme.desc: Legendary African-American folk singer Odetta (1930-2008) sang her spirituals with immeasurable sorrow and anguish. Her spiritual music expresses the horrific impact of slavery on millions of African people stolen from their homeland. For Odetta, folk music—be it spirituals, blues or field songs—was a vehicle for expressing the racism and injustice experienced by black people dating back to the days of slavery.

programme.title: Omer Avital Qantar - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. Israeli-American double bassist Omer Avital plays radiantly energetic, resounding jazz with oriental influences. At Jazz in Duketown 2019, Avital forms a quintet with saxophonists Asaf Yuria and Alexander Levin, drummer Ofri Nehemya, and pianist Eden Ladin.

programme.title: Burton Greene - OTO Part II
programme.desc: Legendary free jazz pianist Burton Greene rose to fame in New York City's free jazz scene of the 1960s. Exploring various spontaneous improvisational styles, Greene performs live at Cafe OTO in London, UK.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Christian Scott
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: The Mel Lewis Orchestra live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Mel Lewis Orchestra was arguably the most influential big band since the swing era.

programme.title: Miriam Makeba Live at Estival Lugano 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Miriam Makeba, also named Mama Africa, was a South African singer, actress, United Nations goodwill ambassador, and civil-rights activist.

programme.title: Jacques Loussier in Leipzig: Play Bach and More
programme.desc: In 1959, Jacques Loussier hit upon the idea that was to make his international reputation, by combining his interest in jazz with his love of J.S. Bach. Only a pianist with such an exceptional classical technique and deft improvisatory skill could have nurtured such a vision. He founded the Play Bach Trio, which used Bach's compositions as the basis for jazz improvisation. The trio immediately caught the public imagination.

programme.title: Bill Evans' European Tour: Live in '64, '65 And '70
programme.desc: Bill Evans: Live in '64, '65 And '70 features five separate performances by one of the most revered pianists in music history. This collection covers an 11-year span, highlighting Evans’ ever-deepening artistry as he performs with four different all-star rhythm sections, including the stunning duo of bassist Niels-Henning Ørsted Pedersen and drummer Alan Dawson.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences. In 2017, French pianist Amaury Faye performed with his trio at Jazz à Vienne.

programme.title: Jazzed Out Oslo
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’.

programme.title: Oscar Peterson - C Jam Blues
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson’s virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964.

programme.title: Kurt Rosenwinkel - Bandit 65
programme.desc: Jazzfest Bonn is an annual festival of modern and creative jazz music. Every May it presents local and international jazz musicians in concert halls all over the German city. Among the artists of the 2017 edition is Bandit 65, a trio of breathtaking virtuosity, great power, boundless breadth, and astounding beauty.

programme.title: Kenny Barron, DPW
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: Freddie Hubbard And The Satchmo Legacy Live in 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. This concert of Freddie Hubbard and the Satchmo Legacy in 1987, highlights the bebop legend's classic style and silky tone.

programme.title: Sunrise
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section.

programme.title: Blicher Hemmer Gadd - A Music documentary
programme.desc: Award-winning saxophonist Michael Blicher, Hammond wizard Dan Hemmer and legendary drummer Steve Gadd joined forces in 2014 to celebrate their shared love for Hammond-organ soul jazz. The band, which tours extensively throughout the world, has released several albums. Their third album, which was released in November 2019, features U.K. vocalist Paul Carrack on the soulful ballad 'The First One To Know'.

programme.title: Count Basie - North Sea Jazz Part II
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Freddie Hubbard Quintet in Brussels, 1980
programme.desc: By the time this set was recorded at Brussels Jazz Club in the summer of 1980, trumpeter Freddie Hubbard had already built an impressive resume. During the 1960s he became a leading voice in the hard bop movement while not shying away from avant-garde sessions with the likes of John Coltrane and Eric Dolphy.

programme.title: Forró Series
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed and curated in São Paulo by director and presenter Dani Gurgel and producer and engineer Thiago Rabello, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor.

programme.title: Les McCann: Live in New Orleans
programme.desc: Self-taught musician Les McCann became the international jazz superstar he is today after the release of his album “Swiss Movement” which he recorded in 1968 with the late Eddie Harris. Yet there is much more to this musician than that one record.

programme.title: Respect to Aretha
programme.desc: To close its 2019 edition, Jazz à la Villette pays tribute to the queen of soul Aretha Franklin, who died in the summer of 2018. The musical direction of the evening has been entrusted to Antibalas, an Afrobeat group from Brooklyn attached to the Daptones label, accompanied for the occasion by several guest singers: Bettye LaVette, José James, Alice Russell, Nona Hendryx And Zara McFarlane.

programme.title: Live at A to JazZ Festival, Sofia
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music”; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content.

programme.title: Starlight
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong: Live in Australia
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly!

programme.title: Jazz a` Vienne 2017
programme.desc: Watch the performance of Jamie Cullum live at Jazz à Vienne, in 2017.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Boogieball with The NPG and Questlove
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Burton Greene - OTO Part IV
programme.desc: Legendary free jazz pianist Burton Greene rose to fame in New York City's free jazz scene of the 1960s. Exploring various spontaneous improvisational styles, Greene performs live at Cafe OTO in London, UK.

programme.title: Diminuendo in Blue and Crescendo in Blue
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Episode 1: Thelonious Monk - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop.

programme.title: Jazz à Ramatuelle: Omar Sosa AfroCubano Quarteto
programme.desc: To call Omar Sosa an Afro-Cuban jazz pianist would only capture part of his true style. Because while he has always kept one foot firmly within the traditions of his native isle, this citizen of the world also shows an insatiable curiosity, tirelessly exploring music from around the world: from the Caribbean to India and from West Africa to the Arab World. Nothing seems to escape his thirst for discovery.

programme.title: Trevor Richards
programme.desc: English drummer Trevor Richards (1945) is a passionate advocate for traditional jazz. After moving to New Orleans at 21 to master the city's unique drumming styles, he has consistently created opportunities to perform with the genre's elder statesmen.

programme.title: Smooth Series at NSJ: George Benson And Kenny G
programme.desc: The world-renowned North Sea Jazz Festival features a wide variety of genres, including traditional New Orleans jazz, swing, bop, free jazz, fusion, avant-garde and electronic jazz, blues, gospel, funk, soul, RAndB, hip hop, world beat and Latin. The festival was founded by entrepreneur and jazz fan Paul Acket, who sold his highly successful pop magazine publishing house to organize and fund the first edition of the festival in 1976.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: World-renowned American blues singer and guitarist Magic Slim performed an electrifying set at the French festival Jazz à Vienne 2012. With bandmates John McDonald (guitar And vocals), Andre Howard (bass), and Brian Jones (drums), the blues giant played a string of classic Chicago blues hits. Ever energetic, the veritable blues veteran put on a dynamic show for an enthusiastic audience in the atmospheric ancient Roman theatre of Vienne.

programme.title: Hamilton e Laginha - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The series Da Pá Virada sessions presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is the duo of Hamilton and Laginha.

programme.title: Grégory Privat - SOLEY
programme.desc: Pianist Grégory Privat's 2020 work 'Soley' inhabits a hybrid universe in which voice, piano and synthesizer, Caribbean and electronic music, and the classical and jazz trio traditions coexist and mingle.

programme.title: The Paris Reunion Band
programme.desc: This assemblage of authentic luminaries recreates the sound of Paris in the 50's and 60's when the City of Light was Europe's mecca for American jazz musicians. The Paris Reunion Band was formed as homage to Kenny Clarke and the spirit of his fellow Paris jazzmen.

programme.title: Aki Rissanen Trio at Jazzclub Unterfahrt, Munich
programme.desc: Aki Rissanen's interest in jazz came after he started taking classical piano lessons. His deep interest in improvised music placed him among top jazz pianist in his home country - Finland. While composing and performing his own music, Rissanen has also collaborated with Verneri Pohjola and Dave Liebman, and today his name appears among the top European jazz musicians.

programme.title: Michelle David - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Shayna Steele
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: DJAZZ Clips
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: The New Conrad Miller Trio Live at Mocher's
programme.desc: Full-time pianist, composer, teacher, and producer Coen Molenaar – aka Conrad Miller – is active all over the world in styles ranging as widely as jazz, fusion, dance, funk, RAndB, rock, and neo-soul. In this 2021 performance from Rossini Studios in Stuttgart, Germany, Miller plays contemporary trio jazz with his bandmates David de Marez Oyens (double bass) and Enrique Firpi (drums).

programme.title: O.P. Trio and E. Fitz. - Jazz At The Philharmonic
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 5, 1957, jazz impresario Norman Granz presented his Jazz at the Philharmonic tour at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Face au Public: Odetta
programme.desc: Legendary African-American folk singer Odetta (1930-2008) sang her spirituals with immeasurable sorrow and anguish. Her spiritual music expresses the horrific impact of slavery on millions of African people stolen from their homeland. For Odetta, folk music—be it spirituals, blues or field songs—was a vehicle for expressing the racism and injustice experienced by black people dating back to the days of slavery.

programme.title: Phalanx - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1985, jazz quartet Phalanx appeared at the festival.

programme.title: Bayerischer Hof Night Club: Gonzalo Rubalcaba Trio
programme.desc: The Cuban pianist, composer and bandleader Gonzalo Rubalcaba is a star name on today's international jazz scene. Technically dazzling and brilliantly creative, Rubalcaba generates infectious excitement with his music. He says he uses jazz as a reference, but takes in the Cuban and African background which was itself an important influence on jazz musicians in the US.

programme.title: Walter Trout Band - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Dee Dee Bridgewater: Motherland
programme.desc: Singer Dee Dee Bridgewater walks in with considerable credentials, but this documentary related to her album ‘Red Earth’ trumps them all: Red Earth is a Malian journey that merges and melts all borders. While world-beat listeners will recognize the grooves, this is Bridgewater's first time bringing her own experiences as an African-American woman back to the motherland. It results in a fusion of feeling, visions, and music.

programme.title: Nubiyan Twist - Music Meeting
programme.desc: Since 1985, the Dutch city of Nijmegen has been welcoming the International Music Meeting Festival every Pentecost. Ranging from jazz and improvisational music to traditional music and unique crossovers, this adventurous festival is all about musical encounters and international collaborations. In 2019, the band Nubiyan Twist performs at the International Music Meeting Festival.

programme.desc: Tempo para relaxar e descontrair com sons e imagens da natureza que acalmam e transmitem uma sensação de tranquilidade. Pode ser um bom momento para adormecer ou simplesmente contemplar e descansar.

programme.title: Judo for the World T1 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Judo for the World features the best competitors in the sport as they compete in a global tour for an opportunity to vie for the gold in the World Judo Championship. In this episode we see the best Judo from the Tokyo Grand Slam where the home nation is looking to dominate as they fielded 7 of Japan's 8 world champions. Plus we catch up with Japan's brother and sister superstars, the Abe's.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 37

programme.title: Greatest Classics T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Hector 'Macho' Camacho, always entertaining and flamboyant, stepping into the ring with 62-4 Tony Menefee in Lincoln, Nebraska. Camacho was on the comeback trail, following an up and down year that saw him defeat the legendary Sugar Ray Leonard by TKO before dropping a unanimous decision to Oscar De La Hoya for the WBC Welterweight Title. With his eyes on another title shot he faces Menefee, in the midst of a 14-fight win streak.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 39
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is Andre Berto defending the WBC welterweight title against former WBA champion Luis Collazo. Each fighter had their own share of getting stunned throughout the bout, and the judges' decision at the end will have some controversy. Also on the card, kickboxing takes center stage as super heavyweight legend Daniel Ghita takes on Gokhan Saki.

programme.title: Pariah: Sonny Liston T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Was Sonny Liston murdered? This four-part documentary series explores the life and untimely death of boxing legend Charles 'Sonny' Liston, who became the heavyweight champion of the world when he knocked out Floyd Patterson in 1962. Unfortunately, just eight years later, he was found dead in his Las Vegas home from an alleged heroin overdose. Suspicion regarding the real cause of his death has continued to this day. Episode 4 of 4.

programme.title: In Der Luft
programme.desc: Histoires courtes - Cycle 'Incorrigibles !' Au cœur de Sarreguemines, ancienne cité ouvrière située à la frontière franco-allemande, Hugo vit l’été de ses 16 ans entre son quartier et les friches industrielles de la ville. Quand il n’est pas juché sur ma mob débridée, le jeune adolescent trompe son manque d’assurance en s’improvisant leader de son trio de copains. Aujourd’hui, il vient de mettre la main sur un authentique pistolet.

programme.title: Le Livreur de Noël
programme.desc: Tandis qu’il attend l’arrivée de ses enfants pour fêter Noël, Julien, en CDD dans une entreprise de livraisons est contraint d’accepter un remplacement au dernier moment. Il promet à ses enfants de rentrer avant minuit et les confie à sa fantasque voisine Olga ! Entre une mauvaise fréquentation du passé qui ressurgit et des livraisons inattendues... le père de famille débute une tournée riche en aventures.

programme.title: La Passion de Dodin Bouffant
programme.desc: Au XIXe siècle, Eugénie est depuis 20 ans cuisinière au service du célèbre gastronome Dodin. A force de passer du temps ensemble dans la cuisine, une passion amoureuse s'est construite entre eux deux. Mais Eugénie n'a jamais voulu se marier avec Dodin, pour garder sa liberté.
